body.zh-HK:
> 面試官問：「政策 assistant 漏掉正確條款。你點樣判斷係 retrieval、generation 定 permission 出錯？」
>
> 答啱一半嘅答案：「我把 top-k 調大。」

用一個固定 case 開始：寫清楚 user role、query、預期 document version、預期 passage、可見權限同可接受答案。同一條 request 漏咗條款時，按固定次序查：**呢個 user 有冇權限睇？→ 系統搵唔搵到正確段落？→ 最後答案有冇跟住段落回答？** 三關分別係 permission、retrieval 同 generation。由第一關開始，先睇 eligibility receipt：喺嗰個時間點，呢位 user 係咪本來應該見到該版本？若唔係，正確結果就係拒絕或 handoff，唔係 retrieval regression。若係，才查 candidate receipt：該 passage 有冇被 index、metadata filter 有冇保留、rank 喺第幾。文件已經到咗 model，才睇 generation receipt：它收到邊幾段、引用咗邊段、reason 係咪真係由嗰段支持。

Top-k 只會改變候選數量，唔會話畀你知錯咗邊一關。正確文件可能根本未 ingestion、被 retriever 排到 cutoff 後、被 reranker 壓低，或者已喺 prompt 裡但 model 冇有按它回答；把 top-k 調大甚至可能帶進更多過期、無關或唔應該見到嘅文件。唔同關口有唔同修復，唔可以用一個設定掩蓋。

## 按呢個次序查

## 讓診斷順著 request 走

一條可追查的 trace 至少包括 query normalisation、role／tenant filter、index snapshot、candidate IDs、rerank score、context assembly、model output、citation validation 和 final route。當文件存在卻未入候選集合，你可以調 query、chunking、metadata 或 hybrid retrieval；當文件本不應出現，修正 permission 或告知 user 無法取得；當文件已入 context 而答案仍然錯，收緊 citation contract、測 output validator 或安排 human review。這樣的回答不會把 search、truth 和 authorisation 混成一件事。

## 反例比一個漂亮答案更有用

固定 fixture 要包含：相同措辭但不同角色的兩位 user、同一政策的新舊版本、一條明顯相關但未獲授權的文件，以及一條 retriever 拿到正確 passage 但 generator 選錯說法的 case。成功標準也要分開：candidate recall、authorised recall、citation support、拒絕是否清楚、以及 human review 是否接受。沒有這些切面，漂亮的 RAG demo 只是在遮掩問題的位置。

## 你在面試中要交出的判斷

先說：『我不會先改 model 或 top-k。我會用同一條 request 的 eligibility、candidate 和 generation receipts 找出錯在何處。』然後用一個 trade-off 收尾：提高 recall 可以增加被 reviewer 看見的文件，卻不可以突破權限，也不可以把舊版本混入現時答案。這樣說明你知道 retrieval 是一條受控供應鏈，而不是一個向量資料庫。

## 可以被打開核對的東西

- **工程：** versioned index manifest、fixture matrix、每一步的 trace、citation validator 和一個修正前後的 regression case。
- **交付：** role、tenant、資料有效期、拒絕文案、例外由誰核准，以及檢索不到時的 handoff。
- **風險：** 不能以『答案看來合理』取代 authorised evidence；沒有可見文件也是一種系統結果。

## 延伸閱讀

[Reranker 救唔返遺失咗嘅 permission](/zh-HK/interview-lab/a-reranker-cannot-restore-a-missing-permission)、[Structured output 唔等於答案有根據](/zh-HK/interview-lab/structured-output-is-not-a-grounding-check) 和 [來源互相矛盾時，要有 owner](/zh-HK/interview-lab/conflicting-sources-need-an-owner)。

> 面试官问：“政策 assistant 漏掉正确条款。你怎样判断是 retrieval、generation 还是 permission 出错？”
>
> 答对一半的答案：“我把 top-k 调大。”

用一个固定 case 开始：指定 user role、query、预期 document version、预期 passage、可见权限与可接受答案。先查 eligibility receipt：在那个时间点，这位 user 是否本来就应看到该版本？若答案是否，这不是 retrieval regression，而是正确的拒绝或 handoff。若答案是，再查 candidate receipt：该 passage 有没有被 index、metadata filter 有没有保留、rank 在第几。最后才看 generation receipt：model 收到哪几段、引用了哪段、reason 是否真被那段支持。

一条可追查的 trace 至少包括 query normalisation、role／tenant filter、index snapshot、candidate IDs、rerank score、context assembly、model output、citation validation 与 final route。当文件存在却未入候选集合，你可以调 query、chunking、metadata 或 hybrid retrieval；当文件本不应出现，修正 permission 或告知 user 无法取得；当文件已入 context 而答案仍然错，收紧 citation contract、测 output validator 或安排 human review。这样的回答不会把 search、truth 与 authorisation 混成一件事。

## 范围说明

这是 AI.DOG 的单题练习。role、tenant、文件与 trace 都是 synthetic 教学材料；不描述任何公司数据库、产品行为或招聘流程。
body.en:
> Interviewer asks: “A policy assistant missed the correct clause. How would you decide whether retrieval, generation, or permission failed?”
>
> Half-right answer: “I would increase top-k.”

Top-k changes the number of candidates; it does not name the layer that lost the answer. The right document may have been excluded by a permission filter, never ingested, ranked below a cutoff, pushed down by a reranker, or already present in the prompt but ignored by the model. Those failures have different repairs. Increasing top-k can also introduce more stale, irrelevant, or impermissible material.

## One wrong answer has three entrances

Start with a fixed case: a user role, query, expected document version, expected passage, visible permissions and an acceptable answer. Check an eligibility receipt first: at that point in time, should this user have been able to see that version? If not, this is not a retrieval regression; refusal or handoff is correct. If yes, inspect a candidate receipt: was the passage indexed, retained by metadata filtering, and ranked high enough? Finally inspect a generation receipt: which passages reached the model, which one it cited, and whether that passage supports the reason.

## Let the diagnosis follow the request

A trace worth debugging includes query normalisation, role/tenant filtering, an index snapshot, candidate IDs, rerank scores, context assembly, model output, citation validation and final route. If a permissible document exists but never becomes a candidate, investigate query, chunking, metadata or hybrid retrieval. If it should not appear, fix permission or explain that access is unavailable. If it reaches context but the answer is still wrong, tighten the citation contract, test an output validator or use human review. This keeps search, truth and authorisation distinct.

## A counterexample is more useful than a pretty answer

Fixed fixtures should include two users with the same wording but different roles, current and superseded versions of one policy, a clearly relevant but unauthorised document, and a case where retrieval finds the right passage but generation chooses the wrong statement. Separate success measures too: candidate recall, authorised recall, citation support, clarity of refusal and human-review acceptance. Without these slices, a polished RAG demo simply hides where the problem lives.

## The judgement to put in your interview answer

Begin: ‘I would not change the model or top-k first. I would use eligibility, candidate and generation receipts for the same request to locate the failure.’ End with a trade-off: higher recall can give a reviewer more documents to inspect, but it cannot override permission or blend a superseded version into today’s answer. That shows retrieval as a controlled supply chain, not just a vector database.

## Things that can be opened and checked

- **Engineering:** a versioned index manifest, fixture matrix, step trace, citation validator and a before/after regression case.
- **Delivery:** role, tenant, data-validity period, refusal copy, who approves an exception, and the handoff when evidence cannot be retrieved.
- **Risk:** an answer that sounds plausible never substitutes for authorised evidence; no visible document is also a system result.

## Further reading

[A reranker cannot restore a missing permission](/en/interview-lab/a-reranker-cannot-restore-a-missing-permission), [Structured output is not a grounding check](/en/interview-lab/structured-output-is-not-a-grounding-check), and [Conflicting sources need an owner](/en/interview-lab/conflicting-sources-need-an-owner).

## Scope note

This is an AI.DOG single-question practice exercise. Roles, tenants, documents and traces are synthetic teaching material; they do not describe any company database, product behaviour, or hiring process.
